notes: Counts are from the cover of the 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (filed September 2026), newer than the Fiscal 2026 10-K cover (645,748,451 shares at March 9, 2026). Only Class C is listed (NYSE: DELL). Classes A and B are priced through DELL because the 10-K's conversion rights let any holder convert them into Class C 'on a one -to-one basis', and Note 14 says all classes share equally in dividends and undistributed earnings. No Class D shares are outstanding.
